description: Michael Dempsey serves as Managing Director, RPX Optimization (US). His listed contact information includes the phone number +1 312‑543‑1616 and the email address MDempsey@RPXOptimization.com.

timeline.entry: Michael Dempsey, Managing Director of RPX Optimization (US), emailed Felix requesting he lead the modeling for a full operational transformation of Alexandria Container & Cargo Handling Co's main container terminal, proposing the engagement be called "Transformation at ACCHCO".

Michael Dempsey, Managing Director of RPX Optimization (US), instructed Felix to lead the modeling for a proposed engagement called "Transformation at ACCHCO" after a first call with ACCHCO's Operations Director regarding an RFP for a full operational transformation at the Port of Alexandria.
Michael Dempsey confirmed participation in the ACCHCO project, approving Felix Kasiske's lead on modeling and the proposed three‑phase diagnostic, redesign, and implementation plan.

Michael Dempsey was addressed by Felix Kasiske as a participant in the ACCHCO project, confirming his involvement in the modeling effort and the three-phase plan to address the fleet and yard congestion issues.
Michael Dempsey, Managing Director of RPX Optimization (US), reported that the project's kickoff in Alexandria took place and Phase 1 diagnostics are now under way.

Michael Dempsey, Managing Director of RPX Optimization (US), reported in an email that a kickoff meeting took place in Alexandria and Phase 1 diagnostics are now underway, with full access to ACCHCO’s terminal operating system data and a yard utilization peak of 94% identified.

Michael Dempsey was informed by Felix Kasiske that Phase 1 of the yard‑congestion simulation was complete, revealing that poor block allocation—not lack of space—caused the congestion and that re‑zoning could recover roughly 20% of effective capacity, prompting a move into Phase 2 redesign.

Michael Dempsey was informed that Phase 1 of the yard‑congestion simulation was complete, confirming that poor block allocation—not lack of space—was the cause and that re‑zoning could recover roughly 20% of effective capacity, and that Phase 2 redesign would begin with a two‑day operations team session scheduled for early May.
Michael Dempsey holds the position of Vice President of Business Development at RPX Optimization LLC, reachable at +1 312‑543‑1616 and MDempsey@RPXOptimization.com.
